clean.title: Clean two-speaker memory trace
clean.protocol: History and query use clean synthetic speech. The excerpt is a fixed multi-evidence case with both cross-user and same-user distractor turns.
clean.queryNote: Fixed example; post-hoc entity annotations are shown for interpretability.
clean.selection: A fixed multi-evidence LoCoMo-ID example with one supporting fact, cross-user distractors, and later same-user returns.
clean.source: Eleven selected history turns across four sessions, plus one first-person query from the clean LoCoMo-ID condition.
clean.evidenceScope: Turn labels are fixed walkthrough annotations, not predictions generated in the browser or a substitute for aggregate evaluation.

spatial.title: Session-shifted history with a held-fixed query
spatial.protocol: The same history text is rendered with session-dependent room, device, gain, and noise shifts. The spoken query remains clean by design, isolating the effect of history-time routing on downstream QA.
spatial.queryNote: The query audio is intentionally identical to the clean case; only history audio changes.
spatial.selection: The clean excerpt is paired turn-for-turn with its session-shifted history realization, so only the history recording condition changes.
spatial.source: Eleven matched history turns under session-dependent acoustic shift; the first-person query is intentionally held fixed.
spatial.evidenceScope: Policy metrics summarize the reported full spatial condition: 30 collections, 60 collection-local gold speakers, and 4,113 speaker-sensitive queries.

four.selection: A fixed original/injected excerpt whose video-games versus board-games replacements are explicitly marked in the benchmark construction.
four.source: Eight interleaved history turns and one first-person query from the four-speaker fact-confusion benchmark.
four.evidenceScope: Each policy panel shows its actual precomputed routing, retrieval, answer, and judge result; policy-local entity IDs are remapped only for display.
